proposals.title: Still flame
proposals.direction: Almost nothing moves: a 240 ms fade on arrival, 150-250 ms ease-out hover changes, chips fading in, a breathing Suggest label while thinking; no travel.

proposals.title: Kindling
proposals.direction: The glow answers you: it kindles on arrival with a staggered rise, grows with the length of the typed subject, and swells as the button flares on submit.

proposals.title: Embers
proposals.direction: The learning node's language: a light crosses the underline on arrival, runs into the button on submit and bursts, embers rise while Suggest thinks, a light runs through a hovered thumbnail.
